answer: A farm of 154 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in jade, queued in cipher, and horizon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 80 identities per epoch. A farm of 2350 identities would post 4850 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
